description: DFlash2 verify steps of Muse Spark at TP8 (requests x 8 rows; 8, 16 and 64 rows: one, two and eight requests, three compiled widths) over a full-attention layer, with the longest request's context ctx taken from the AgentX decode-step-weighted context distribution (semianalysisai/cc-traces-weka-062126 rev 23f152f6, 98,827 requests: p10 51,891, p25 108,326, p50 219,840, p75 426,387, p90 631,824, p99 889,977 keys; share of decode steps by context bucket: <=4K 4.4%, 4-64K 9.2%, 64-128K 17.0%, 128-256K 25.9%, 256-512K 26.9%, 512K-1M 16.7%) and the AgentX per-session in-flight distribution (one request in flight 90% of the busy time). The other requests of a step hold between ceil(ctx/2) and ctx keys. Derived from corpus statistics; not yet confirmed by a live capture. Context cap assumed 1,048,576 (the model's maximum context is not in the source; AgentX's maximum is 990K). Short contexts, the boundary shapes and the cap are correctness-only.

cases.source: boundary: one request whose only keys are the step's 8 rows (minimum requests and context; the causal mask alone shapes the rows)
boundary: non-power-of-two short context (AgentX <=4K bucket, 4.4% of decode steps); 12 partitions, merged in one level
boundary: context not a multiple of 16 (a partial last page), two requests; 17 partitions, two-level merge with an empty level-1 group
eight short ragged requests (64 rows, the largest compiled width), contexts across the 2048-key chunk boundary
the step's rows straddle a chunk boundary (keys % 256 = 3) inside a two-chunk partition, where the upstream kernel's mask failed (README.md); AgentX 16-32K bucket
AgentX 4-64K bucket (9.2% of decode steps), R=1 x 8-row verify; one chunk a CTA, near the 10 us floor, so correctness-only
the assumed 1M context cap (AgentX request max 990K; no request exceeds 1M)
AgentX decode-weighted low end (16-64K: 8.4% of decode steps), R=1 x 8-row verify (C1, the interactive width)
AgentX decode-weighted p25 (108K; 64-128K bucket, 17.0% of decode steps), R=1 x 8-row verify
AgentX decode-weighted p50 (220K; 128-256K bucket, 25.9% of decode steps), R=1 x 8-row verify
AgentX decode-weighted p75 (426K; 256-512K bucket, 26.9% of decode steps), R=1 x 8-row verify
AgentX decode-weighted p90 (632K; 512K-1M bucket, 16.7% of decode steps), R=1 x 8-row verify
AgentX decode-weighted p99 (890K), R=1 x 8-row verify
AgentX decode p50 (220K), R=2 x 8-row verify (C2, the second default served width; two requests in flight 5.4% of the busy time)
AgentX decode p25 (108K), R=8 x 8-row verify (64 rows, the largest compiled width)
AgentX decode p75 (426K), R=8 x 8-row verify (64 rows)
